nonpositive_category_changes.notice: Neither category is a positive indicator flag. Keep applicability distinctions visible; do not call every literal category mismatch a flag reversal.

conservative_author_endorsement.definition: indicator + meets_criterion + attribution author + speaker_stance supports + not hypothetical

source.title: A Definition of Anti-Muslim Hostility
source.author: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source.institution: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source.rights_note: Exclude source images, logos and seals. Retain bibliographic citations and short contextual quotations with attribution; separately credited third-party reproductions require their own rights. No exhaustive legal-clearance claim.

primary.speaker: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
primary.proposition: Treating Muslims as a collective group defined by fixed and negative characteristics based on ethnic or racial backgrounds is anti-Muslim hostility.
primary.explanation: The definition includes treating Muslims as a collective group with fixed negative characteristics based on ethnic or racial backgrounds.

exact_evidence.quote: It is also the prejudicial stereotyping of Muslims, or people perceived to be Muslim including because of their ethnic or racial backgrounds or their appearance, and treating them as a collective group defined by fixed and negative characteristics, with the intention of encouraging hatred against them, irrespective of their actual opinions, beliefs or actions as individuals.

worked_examples.reading_guidance_authorship: AI-authored questions, not human adjudication or reference labels
review_questions: Does this passage define prejudicial racialization, enact it, or attribute it to another speaker?
Under the operational criterion, should discussing a harmful mechanism count as applying that mechanism? Keep this question separate from author endorsement.
